name: Totalbanken A/S
summary: Totalbanken A/S provides various banking products and services to private households, and small and medium-sized enterprises in Denmark. The company offers savings accounts, deposits, and guarantees; and car loans, investment products, pension products, leasing services, and insurance products. It operates through 1 branch in Tommerup and 2 branches in Odense. The company was founded in 1911 and is headquartered in Aarup, Denmark.
